description: Lists the PNS Credentials associated with a notification hub .

operations.description: Lists the PNS Credentials associated with a notification hub .

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: Gets subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: The AdmCredential of the created NotificationHub
props.name: admCredential

props.description: The URL of the authorization token.
props.name: authTokenUrl

props.description: The ApnsCredential of the created NotificationHub
props.name: apnsCredential

props.description: The APNS certificate. Specify if using Certificate Authentication Mode.
props.name: apnsCertificate

props.description: The issuer (iss) registered claim key. The value is a 10-character TeamId, obtained from your developer account. Specify if using Token Authentication Mode.
props.name: appId

props.description: The name of the application or BundleId. Specify if using Token Authentication Mode.
props.name: appName

props.description: The APNS certificate password if it exists.
props.name: certificateKey

props.description: The APNS endpoint of this credential. If using Certificate Authentication Mode and Sandbox specify 'gateway.sandbox.push.apple.com'. If using Certificate Authentication Mode and Production specify 'gateway.push.apple.com'. If using Token Authentication Mode and Sandbox specify 'https://api.development.push.apple.com:443/3/device'. If using Token Authentication Mode and Production specify 'https://api.push.apple.com:443/3/device'.
props.name: endpoint

props.description: A 10-character key identifier (kid) key, obtained from your developer account. Specify if using Token Authentication Mode.
props.name: keyId

props.description: The APNS certificate thumbprint. Specify if using Certificate Authentication Mode.
props.name: thumbprint

props.description: Provider Authentication Token, obtained through your developer account. Specify if using Token Authentication Mode.
props.name: token

props.description: The BaiduCredential of the created NotificationHub
props.name: baiduCredential

props.description: The GcmCredential of the created NotificationHub
props.name: gcmCredential

props.description: The FCM legacy endpoint. Default value is 'https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send'
props.name: gcmEndpoint

props.description: The MpnsCredential of the created NotificationHub
props.name: mpnsCredential

props.description: The certificate key for this credential.
props.name: certificateKey

props.description: The WnsCredential of the created NotificationHub
props.name: wnsCredential

props.description: The package ID for this credential.
props.name: packageSid

props.description: The sku of the created namespace
props.name: sku

props.description: Name of the notification hub sku
props.name: name

responses.description: Gets all the NotificationHub PNS credentials
